findings.title: New table visualization discards the query results
findings.body: When the organization has `use-table-widget-visualization` enabled, every dashboard table is rendered with empty columns, empty rows, and empty metadata instead of the fetched `result`. Consequently, populated widgets appear empty regardless of their query results. Pass the actual result data and corresponding columns/metadata to the new visualization before enabling this branch.

findings.title: Attribute cache key no longer distinguishes organizations
findings.body: The new React Query key contains only query options, although the query function requests an organization-specific endpoint. With identical filters (for example, all projects and the default date range), switching organizations reuses the previous organization's cached attribute collection and can also share an in-flight request. Include the organization slug in the query key so attribute suggestions cannot come from a different organization.

findings.title: Normalize error and recording timestamps before merging
findings.body: Error timestamps fetched from nodestore are Unix seconds, whereas raw rrweb recording event timestamps are Unix milliseconds. Comparing them directly makes errors appear earlier than all recording events, so errors occurring midway through a replay are emitted at the beginning of the summary input rather than alongside the relevant breadcrumbs. Normalize the recording timestamp to seconds (or the error timestamp to milliseconds) before comparing. The new tests use seconds for recording timestamps and therefore do not exercise the production format.
